send_bulk_email.description: Send a stored template to many recipients in one call, each as a separate email with its own variables. Returns each recipient's status; the step fails only if none was sent.
send_bulk_email.name: send_bulk_email

parameters.description: The sender: a verified email address, or any address at a verified domain, in the connection's region. 'Ana <ana@example.com>' sets a display name.
parameters.name: from_email

parameters.description: The stored template to send.
parameters.name: template_name

parameters.description: One entry per email: an address, or an object with 'to' (address or list), optional 'cc'/'bcc', and 'template_data' overriding the defaults. While the account is in the SES sandbox every recipient must be a verified identity or the mailbox simulator (success@simulator.amazonses.com).
parameters.name: entries

parameters.description: Variables used for every recipient unless their entry sets its own.
parameters.name: default_template_data

parameters.description: Addresses replies should go to.
parameters.name: reply_to

parameters.description: Optional configuration set to send through, for event tracking and delivery options.
parameters.name: configuration_set_name

parameters.description: Name/value tags attached to every message.
parameters.name: default_email_tags

results.description: One result per entry, in order.

status.description: SUCCESS, or the reason the entry was not sent.
